source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Assuming every stroke client carries essentially the same fall risk, without conducting any individualized bedside assessment specific to that client first","B":"Individualized fall risk assessment, appropriate assistive devices, and close supervision during mobility, given the significantly increased fall risk in this population","C":"Fairly few precautions actually applied beyond what would typically be used for any other hospitalized client on the medical-surgical unit","D":"Restricting the client's mobility altogether in an effort to eliminate fall risk completely for the remainder of the hospital stay"}}
source_row.rationale: Fall prevention for a client with post-stroke weakness and impaired balance includes individualized fall risk assessment, appropriate assistive devices, and close supervision during mobility, while still supporting appropriate mobility and rehabilitation progress.
source_row.source_detail: Individualized Fall Prevention for Stroke Clients
